bosses.name: The Glide
bosses.what: How far a planted foot slides while Tom walks, stops and turns.
bosses.last: 27 Oct: found that Epic's walk and Tom's MetaHuman had never reached the packaged game (their files never went to the build machine); fixed, and the AI tester walked the whole route in it, 15 of 15. The first stop still drags 10 to 13 cm inside Epic's own clip; your eye passed it.

bosses.name: The Long Pause
bosses.what: Seconds from the end of your question to the character's first sound.
bosses.last: 4 Nov: run F, twenty different newcomer questions in the packaged game: a median 2.02 s against 2.0 s, 7 of 30 at 4 s or more. Three tries spent; the bar is missed and reported at the exit.

bosses.name: The Stutter
bosses.what: The worst single frame on a walk down the street.
bosses.last: 8 Nov: the night's walk, 16 of 17 stages: 58.2 fps, worst frame 22.37 ms, none over 33.3 ms. The rare freeze of 6 Nov stays listed at the exit. Tries spent.

bosses.name: The Tailor
bosses.what: Period clothes on the cast, counted by pieces, starting with Tom's four. A piece is beaten when it passes in the packaged game with no open fault.
bosses.display: 3 of 4 pieces settled; the jacket set aside
bosses.last: Interim: two men dressed on the floor; the Tailor still standing. 8 Nov: Ron and Darren in wool-knit jumpers (Ron navy, Darren maroon) and jeans passed your look on the clothes' floor, an interim pass only; from tonight they wear them in the game you play, and tonight's walk is their first test there. Tom's jacket stays set aside and listed at the exit; clothing is far from done.

pieces.name: Jacket
pieces.line: Set aside after four tries: his neck shows at the collar, front and back, when his head turns. Listed at the exit.

pieces.name: Jumper
pieces.line: Made and held: unseen under the zipped jacket, its place decided 4 Nov.

pieces.name: Jeans
pieces.line: Passed packaged 4 Nov: the straight cut over his boots, no new fault.

pieces.name: Boots
pieces.line: Passed packaged 4 Nov. Known: no toe-cap seam or lacing; the toe's shape and the pale band stay listed.

pieces.name: Ron and Darren
pieces.line: Interim: two men dressed on the floor (his yes 8 Nov); tailor boss standing. Left: a real wool knit with ribbing, a colour each, Darren's stiff neckband.

bosses.name: The Empty Chair
bosses.what: Someone sits down in the game as you play it.
bosses.display: Sits and stands packaged, face up; his head swings in the drop, set aside
bosses.last: 6 Nov: in the packaged film his face is at most 10 degrees down and he sits and stands with nothing touched; a fresh reviewer found his head swinging round in the drop. Tries spent; listed at the exit.

bosses.name: The Clean Room
bosses.what: Mickey's office worn, lived in and free of glitches, at the Hook sheet's bar.
bosses.display: Passed packaged 4 Nov; the exit re-check to come
bosses.last: 8 Nov: the office as the game you play draws it, by day and night, one fresh reviewer: no new fault. Listed: the room's light wear, the night room lit by hard warm light, the damp stain's cut-out edge, Tom's pale crown.

bosses.name: The Memory Hog
bosses.display: 6,005 MB on 8 Nov (a middle reading, not the peak); being looked at
bosses.last: 8 Nov: 6,005 MB in the night's walk, a middle reading, not a peak; 6,089 the night before. Your ruling of 24 Oct: the 6 GB line counts the game alone; whether these readings are the game alone is being checked.

bosses.name: The Shadow Tax
bosses.what: Spare graphics card time, kept for what the street still needs.
